newsitem.title: CHINA: China's CITIC says to issue $150 mln FRN in May.
newsitem.headline: China's CITIC says to issue $150 mln FRN in May.

text.p: The China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC) will launch a $150 million floating rate note issue in May, with further issues to follow if market reaction is favourable, a company official said on Wednesday.
The FRN would be distributed in Asia and Europe, said the official. She gave no details of maturity or returns.
"If the market reaction is favourable, we may make further issues," she said but declined to give details.
The China Business Times said CITIC was preparing to issue up to $250 million in FRNs, but the company official said such a large amount was unlikely.
CITIC's issues would be lead managed by Credit Suisse First Boston, the newspaper said.
The CITIC issue follows the introduction of a $100 million FRN by the China Investment Bank last week.

The investment bank's FRN matures in five years and was launched and re-offered at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. Fees are 35 basis points to give an all-in return of 53 basis points.
